parsed.title: Deep Reasoning Session Pass
parsed.oneLiner: Allow guests to sample deep reasoning mode for 15 minutes by engaging with a rewarded mini-game.

newMechanic.name: Deep Reasoning Session Pass
newMechanic.description: An ephemeral, time-boxed 15-minute entitlement to deep reasoning mode earned via a rewarded ad, separate from the Luzia+ subscription.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Provides a high-value sample for non-paying users to experience premium capabilities, driving upgrade intent without devaluing the permanent subscription.

parsed.trigger: User taps 'Toggle deep reasoning mode' or 'Start a task' on the Attachment and Mode Sheet (s27), triggering the subscription paywall (s07).
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying guest users hitting the Luzia+ subscription wall.

offer.title: Unlock Deep Reasoning
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to unlock 15 minutes of deep reasoning mode.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Gated strictly to non-paying guests; session is time-boxed to 15 minutes (short duration); cap of 2 per day prevents power-usage substitution; paywall remains the primary CTA.
risks: Inference COGS for premium reasoning models must be strictly monitored per user.
Risk of users habituating to the 15-minute window instead of converting.

newElements.change: Button: Watch ad to unlock 15m deep reasoning

callouts.text: Deep reasoning is locked for guests

storyboard.caption: Deep reasoning mode is exclusively for Luzia+ subscribers.
A new option to unlock via rewarded ad appears on the wall.
User chooses to watch an ad instead of subscribing.
Deep reasoning is unlocked for the next 15 minutes.
